limitations: Report findings are not experiment rows. No FLEX measurements have been normalized.

Original 131 records and their missing pressure/gravity/outcome fields remain unchanged.
FLEX CSV/report test1 diameter disagreement and ambiguous burning-rate units require reconciliation before import.
Cool-flame evidence was not curated from these selected passages; absence here is not absence from FLEX research.
